_about: RECORDED JUDGMENT (hand-authored) for the Layer-3 pass-2 fine-label re-derivation (EG-7 / OI-84 / OI-100). One entry per frozen blind row. The fine label is derived from the row's IDENTITY + COARSE label + PROSE REASONING ALONE (the frozen pass2_blind_reading / pass2_blind_errorrate artifacts) - no source read, no manifest, no re-measure, blind to pass 1. Each 'reason' code deterministically maps to a fine verdict + a prose_decided flag + the axis it belongs to (see tools/audit/l3/relabel_fine.py REASON_MAP). The mapping of a row to its reason code IS the judgment; the script does only parse/join/count/render. 'note' records the row-specific judgment where it is not mechanical.

_reason_codes.CODE_LIVE: Prose asserts the code is correct/live with no deadness or retirement signal -> SURVIVES (code axis).
_reason_codes.STRUCT_THEORY: Prose grounds the literal as a music-theory / pitch-class / scale-degree fact -> ESTABLISHED (constants axis).
_reason_codes.STRUCT_MECH: Prose grounds the literal as code mechanics (array size, capacity hint, mod-12, zero-init, div-guard, structural sigmoid constant, structural half) -> ESTABLISHED (constants axis).
_reason_codes.STRUCT_BOUND: Prose identifies the literal as a fitter search-range bound with the default confirmed inside it -> ESTABLISHED (constants axis).
_reason_codes.FITTED_UNRESOLVED: Prose argues empirical / in-bounds / theory-ordering / live but never engages fit provenance, which is what separates ESTABLISHED from UNFIT -> UNRESOLVABLE-FROM-PROSE (constants axis).
_reason_codes.FITTED_PROVISIONAL_UNFIT: Prose explicitly flags the fit as provisional / not-final, so it is not positively established (principle 19); live, not dead -> UNFIT (constants axis).
_reason_codes.PUB_CONSUMER: Prose names a live consumer of the derived fact -> PUBLISHED (derived-facts axis).
_reason_codes.DEAD_VESTIGIAL: Prose says the field/write is read nowhere / vestigial -> DEAD (constants axis).
